name: The Last Customer
storyline:
During a late-night shift at an ordinary restaurant, strange things begin to happen.
Customers keep arriving… but something about them feels wrong.

Their behavior is unsettling. Their words don’t always make sense.
Some of them may not even be human.

As the night goes on, an unseen presence begins to emerge.
Watching. Waiting. Getting closer.

The line between reality and illusion slowly breaks.
But the job must go on… even if something doesn’t want you to.
summary:
A normal shift at a restaurant… until it isn’t.
Strange customers. Unnatural behavior.
Some of them are not human.

Something is watching from the dark.

Reality vs illusion.
Keep working… even if something doesn’t want you to.

Playtime: 10–12 minutes (depending on how you play)
